title: Refactor safely
whenToUse: Behavior must stay identical while structure improves.
whenNotToUse: You are mid-feature and lack tests.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Refactor {{target}} with zero behavior change.

CONTEXT:
Tests that must stay green: {{tests}}.

INPUT:
Smell: {{smell}}.

CONSTRAINTS:
- No API changes
- Keep commits semantic
- Stop if tests fail

OUTPUT:
Plan + incremental steps

ACCEPTANCE:
Same tests pass; diff is structural.

VERIFICATION:
Run listed tests yourself.
badPrompt: Clean up the whole repo style.
improvedPrompt: Extract validation helper in auth module only; keep public API; run unit tests.
privacySecurityNotes: Do not include production data dumps
